description: This file defines an asynchronous observable interface for streaming data in Orleans, enabling asynchronous subscription and data processing.

classes.name: IAsyncObservable<T>
classes.description: An interface providing asynchronous subscription methods for observables of type T, allowing consumers to subscribe to data streams asynchronously with optional offset tokens and filters.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribe a consumer to the observable stream asynchronously with optional starting sequence token and filter data.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Overload that subscribes a consumer with an optional stream sequence token and filter data.
